text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Our second summer training camp begins! 
Once again, volunteers have kindly agreed 
to help us with areas where we're 
short-handed."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for calling! ♪ Fufufu, it seems 
you've arrived safely at the training camp 
facility."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Please leave everything regarding the 
Yukoma Onsen to us this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, don't worry about things here. Just 
focus on your training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much. Come autumn, I shall 
show you an updated version of myself."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm really looking forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Have all of you heard the news 
about that girl yet?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It's that girl you guys helped with rehab 
the other day.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I'll paste the link to the news site. 
There we go.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't this breaking news about her 
comeback?! "Her next race is set, and 
preparations seem to be going smoothly," 
it says! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Stop, stop! If you get too close~~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My contact with electronic devices carries 
the risk of triggering mysterious 
errors...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm sorry too! But it'll really 
break, you know~. It just can't be helped, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will check the physical copy later. 
Adding "trip to convenience store" to my 
lunch break task list.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: On race day, let's go cheer them on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Filled with heartwarming emotions, her 
motivation for the training camp soared as 
well!
